_about: One Meshy text-to-3D prompt per weapon (original designs). tools/meshy_generate.py sends these, downloads the .glb and runs import_model.py. Edit freely; 'image' can point to a reference picture (image-to-3D) instead.

holoar.prompt: modern assault rifle with a holographic red dot sight, slim M-LOK handguard, suppressor, collapsible stock, matte graphite with dark bronze accents, game-ready weapon, side view, highly detailed

smg.prompt: compact submachine gun with a short barrel, small reflex sight, folding stock, straight box magazine, matte black polymer and steel, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

lmg.prompt: belt-fed light machine gun with a box ammo pouch, folded bipod, carry handle, 4x prism scope, olive drab and gunmetal, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

shotgun.prompt: pump-action tactical breacher shotgun, short barrel with a breaching muzzle, shell holder on the receiver, orange-tan polymer furniture, black steel, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

dmr.prompt: semi-automatic designated marksman rifle with a medium scope, free-float handguard, adjustable cheek rest stock, tan and black, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

hunter.prompt: classic bolt-action rifle with a full-length stock, two barrel bands, turned-down bolt handle, open iron sights, black white and mint splatter camo finish, small laser under the muzzle, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

sniper.prompt: heavy bolt-action sniper rifle with a long scope, muzzle brake, folding bipod, skeleton stock with adjustable cheek piece, matte black and grey, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

pistol.prompt: modern polymer-frame semi-automatic pistol with a slide-mounted mini red dot, black slide, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

revolver.prompt: heavy six-shot revolver with a long fluted barrel, swing-out cylinder, wooden grip, polished stainless steel, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

tracker.prompt: hunting knife with a drop-point blade, flat grind line, thumb studs, black textured handle with a metal guard, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

bayonet.prompt: military bayonet knife with a clip-point blade, ribbed black grip, crossguard with a muzzle ring, pommel latch, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

knife.prompt: karambit knife with a slender curved claw blade, finger ring at the end of the handle, black handle scales, game-ready weapon, highly detailed

butterfly.prompt: butterfly knife balisong with two skeletonized handles, latch, tanto blade, polished steel, game-ready weapon, highly detailed
